seed_noise._comment: v4 の必須項目。δ の導出はこの値を**入力に取らない**(FR-029)。

selected_rule: stack127 iff both completed 113 increment/anchor reports are RETAIN_SUPPORTED or RETAIN_UNCERTAIN; otherwise pruning125. Freeze 113 summary/reports/receipts and record branch; no discretionary selection.

correction.fit: selected-model win probabilities, canonical eligible races, only strictly earlier years
correction.apply: All started horses; year-constant gamma. Normalize p*exp(gamma*h), verify strictly positive/interior, assemble_predictions(eps=0.0) for coherent Harville top2/top3; no second isotonic fit or clipping.

limitations: Historical selection-used full-information data, not unused confirmation or preweight serving evidence.
2019 is coefficient warmup only; primary evaluation counts cover 2020..2026-08-23.
All v4 quality guards measured, but research disposition cannot activate a model.

sd_fold=.001816/k_seeds=1 is transferred from the base booster, not an empirical estimate of gamma-refit variability. Race-day bootstrap holds fitted gamma fixed; total CI does not establish coverage of all correction uncertainty.
Coefficient selection/fitting gain is not a guarantee that a booster feature addition improves prediction.
No annual confirmation slot, seed followup or production mutation is performed.
research_progression: Keep selected+gap correction for next seed/future confirmation only when BOTH increment and anchor contrasts are RETAIN_SUPPORTED or RETAIN_UNCERTAIN. If either is DEFER/BLOCKED, defer the correction and preserve the 113-selected base.
